question: Subtract the sum of 2x - 3y + 7z and 4z - 5x from 13x - z.
solution:
**Given:**

Subtract the sum of 2x - 3y + 7z and 4z - 5x from 13x - z.

**Formula used:**

(13x - z) - [(2x - 3y + 7z) + (4z - 5x)]

**Calculation:**

(13x - z) - [(2x - 3y + 7z + 4z - 5x)]

⇒ (13x - z) - [2x + 4z - 5x - 3y + 7z]

⇒ (13x - z) - [-3x - 3y + 11z]

⇒ 13x - z + 3x + 3y - 11z

⇒ 16x + 3y - 12z

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
